Thank you for your application for the Python BackEnd Developer position. We will not move forward with your application because your CV does not show the following required experiences:

- 5 years of software development experience (only 0.5 years mentioned)
- 2 years of experience developing big systems with Python
- Experience with asynchronous programming and performance-critical applications
